data.content_ref: inline:SRC_003 contradicts SRC_002 because they apply the same pizza-cutting scenario to incompatible interpretive frameworks: SRC_003 adopts a topological measure-theoretic lens yielding 1 piece, while SRC_002 adopts a combinatorial general-position lens yielding 11 pieces. The contradiction is REFUTED IF the two frameworks are shown to be compatible under a unified partition theory — for instance, if the topological remainder (1 connected component) and the combinatorial sectors (11 bounded regions) are recognized as different answers to different questions rather than contradictory answers to the same question, in which case the relation becomes abstraction rather than contradiction.
